name: Boxer Rat
description: Throws hands at anyone who looks at its modaks.
flavor_text: Undefeated, mostly because nobody wants to fight a rat.

name: Empty Wallet Rat
description: Has never once had a modak to its name.

name: Hoodie Rat
description: Keeps its face hidden. Nobody knows why.

name: Screaming Rat
description: Has one volume: maximum.
flavor_text: Nobody knows what it's screaming about.

name: Surprised Rat
description: Perpetually caught off guard.

name: Biker Rat
description: Rides through the server on two wheels.
flavor_text: Revs its engine even when it doesn't have one.

name: Lovely Rat
description: Just a genuinely nice rat.
flavor_text: Everyone's favorite, and it knows it.

name: Raging Rat
description: Furious about something, unclear what.

name: Teeth Rat
description: All teeth, no chill.

name: Enraged Rat
description: Past raging. Fully enraged now.
flavor_text: The Raging Rat's angrier older cousin.

name: Sleepy Rat
description: Asleep through the entire festival.
flavor_text: Will wake up when the modaks run out.

name: Sus Rat
description: Definitely up to something.

name: Caught Rat
description: Got caught red-handed. Unrepentant about it.

name: Hihihi Rat
description: Giggling for reasons nobody understands.

name: Middle Finger Rat
description: Has strong opinions about being caught.

name: Robber Rat
description: Has stolen more modaks than anyone can count.

name: Why I Oughta Rat
description: Perpetually one insult away from a fight.

name: Bal Ganesha
description: A young, playful companion said to bring good fortune.
flavor_text: Small in size, enormous in blessings.

name: Laddu Mushak
description: Surrounded by an ever-present cloud of laddu crumbs.
flavor_text: Has never met a laddu it didn't finish.

name: Dhol Rat
description: Keeps the beat for the whole procession.
flavor_text: The rhythm follows wherever it goes.

name: Shankh Rat
description: Announces the start of every aarti.
flavor_text: Its call carries across the whole server.

name: Aarti Mushak
description: Said to appear only during the most sacred moment of the aarti.
